collectFees(uint256).notice: MonLock-compatible. Permissionless keeper collect. Pays USDC legs, burns sell-side         launch token, accrues project-burn USDC. Does not swap. Does not cook.

creatorSplits(uint256).notice: MonLock-compatible view: stamped creator wallet + bps.

keepers(address).notice: Addresses allowed to execute the project-burn swap. The owner is always allowed.

lock(uint256,address,uint8,address,strin.notice: Stamp creator + kind + referrer code and take the LP NFT. Factory (or owner) only.         Empty `referrerCode` means no referrer (500 bps → Crucible). Code need not be         registered yet; collect resolves the current payout from the registry.

owed(address,address).notice: token => account => USDC (or other) that failed to push (e.g. Circle blacklist).

projectBurn(uint256,uint256).notice: Swap accrued project-burn USDC for the launch token and send it to dead.         Keeper-gated: `minLaunchOut` is caller-supplied, so an open entrypoint could pass 1         and accept a manipulated price. Reverts on a collapsed price instead of burning dust.

quoteSplit(uint256,uint8,bool).notice: Pure split of a USDC fee amount. Remainder (rounding dust) goes to Crucible.

withdrawNft(uint256).notice: Intentionally unimplemented. LP NFT stays in this contract forever.

withdrawOwed(address,address).notice: Pull a failed push (blacklist, etc.). Anyone may push to `to`.
